purpose: N1 checkpoint 1: name the inputs a bounded learned-singer experiment needs, and state which are present. This is not a training authorization, a corpus approval or a quality claim.

host.note: CPU training on this host is bounded by the ceiling in trainingBounds, not by the machine's nominal capacity.

trainingBounds.cancellation: stop token checked between steps; checkpoint written before any stop is honoured
trainingBounds.note: A run specification is written before any sustained run, and a short throughput smoke run sizes the next one. These are ceilings for an experiment, not a schedule.

corpus.reason: No authorized singing corpus is present. tests/singing_quality/corpus holds four diagnostic scores and one public-domain spoken-voice bank notice, which is not training material: the same notice records that it cannot demonstrate intelligible singing.
corpus.unblocks: An authorized corpus with source-group splits, retained provenance and a real recording, or an explicit decision to train on authorized generated material.

labels.reason: Labels are derived from the corpus, so the label admission path exists (admit-labels) but has no admitted input to consume. The word-aligned and phone-level annotation review the pipeline requires has not been performed on any real recording.

acousticProfile.note: This is the pilot's language and pitch-layer record, not the 48 kHz / 80-bin / hop-256 acoustic target the training tooling binds. The training profile object must be produced from a corpus before training.

vocoderProfile.reason: No vocoder is admitted. VOCODER_INTAKE.md records that published OpenVPI vocoders are 44.1 kHz / 128-bin / hop-512 with CC BY-NC-SA pretrained weights, against SEAM's 48 kHz / 80-bin / hop-256 target, so no published checkpoint is a drop-in and its weights are not commercially admissible without a separate rights decision.

upstreamRevision.note: Pinned upstream source and a working local model environment exist. Upstream executes Python code, so the checkout is trusted-local material, not an untrusted-input sandbox.

permissionEvidence.reason: No training permission manifest with byte-bound evidence exists. The admission path (permission-report, admit) is implemented and deliberately refuses to authorize training on its own, and model training and redistribution are separate scopes from any bank permission.

existingCapability.note: These are implemented and tested, and none of them is a learned singer. Recorded here so the missing inputs are not confused with missing code.
existingCapability.trainingPrimitive: DiffSinger DDPM architecture, bounded training, checkpoint and resume exist in tools/voice_model_training.
existingCapability.acousticExport: A real trained checkpoint exports to ONNX and passes native inspection and ORT smoke execution; the training diagnostic itself used oscillator fixtures.
existingCapability.workerDeployment: Bundle admission, the shipped worker, and render integration are tested; the song proof used arithmetic graphs.
existingCapability.qualification: qualify-candidate drives the worker over held-out items and always reports UNRESOLVED, because intelligibility, identity and musicality need independent listeners.

nextBoundedAction.step: Build the model-only vocoder bridge at SEAM's own profile (48 kHz, 80 mel, hop 256, upsample product 256) and prove exact dynamic output lengths and finite reconstruction before any acoustic training run.
nextBoundedAction.why: A geometry and reconstruction check is cheap, needs no corpus and catches a profile mismatch before a long run is sized against it. Random initialization is a geometry diagnostic, not a singer.
nextBoundedAction.notClaimed: This is not a vocoder qualification, a corpus substitute or evidence that any voice is intelligible.
